name: hand-drawn-hatching
title: Hand Drawn Hatching
description: A drifting shadow field drawn the way an illustrator shades with a pen: up to four layers of cross-hatching, each stroke wobbling, tapering and lifting off the paper, with hand-animated line boil. A lamp clears the shading: it follows the pointer and drifts on its own when idle, and a soft clearing keeps the middle bare for hero content.
